comments.author: S13NDR_M4N
comments.body_html:
If you dont have a winrar equivalent able to open ZIP files on your computer like 7zip- you may not be able to open the DL folders

Install a compression manager and then you can drag content into the SPT/user/mods folder

If a mod contains bepinex/plugins - those are mods that can be configured inside the Tarkov.exe game application while the game is open by hitting the F12 key

Mods may contain files that go into both folders

By dragging files directly from 7 zip into the appropriate folders- they should cache themselves into the right place

If a mod isnt in the BEPINEX/plugins or user/mods folder- it will not be loaded by the server or tarkov.exe
